name: Formula Traffic Racer: F1 Car Racing
summary:
A formula cockpit. An endless highway. One more gap.

Formula Traffic Racer: F1 car racing puts you low to the road, with exposed wheels beside you and highway traffic ahead. Grab the virtual steering wheel, squeeze the accelerator, and thread your way through cars and vans on a forest-lined road.

CHASE THE CLEAN RUN.
Push past 100 km/h to start scoring. Earn rewards for clean overtakes and build your multiplier up to x3. Stay above 200 km/h for speed-streak bonuses while the cockpit display tracks your sp
